channel.title: Merkle Street
channel.description: Merkle Street reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, layer 2s, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and protocol upgrades.

item.title: BLS Signature Aggregation in an AVS, Step by Step
item.description: BLS signature aggregation in an AVS combines Operators’ signatures on one message into one proof, which a contract checks against quorum stake to confirm it.

item.title: Chainflip says attacker stole 122.86 BTC in $12m vault raid
item.description: Chainflip says an attacker stole 122.86 BTC alongside ETH and stablecoins, lifting losses to about $12 million as the protocol offers a 10% return bounty.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2bn in crypto stolen from Binance as tracing and forfeiture efforts continue.

item.title: How to connect MetaMask to ShibaSwap and check your network
item.description: To connect MetaMask to shiba swap, open the trusted interface, choose MetaMask, approve the intended account, then confirm the active network before using the app.

item.title: How to Set Up MetaMask and Get Your First Address
item.description: How to set up a MetaMask wallet step by step: install the official extension, create and back up your wallet, then copy your first receiving address.

item.title: Polygon PoS State Sync: How Deposits Get Minted
item.description: Why bridged tokens arrive on Polygon without paying gas: Heimdall validators relay the Ethereum event, then Bor mints your deposit by system call.

item.title: DBS and Circle open 24/7 USDC access to institutions in Asia
item.description: DBS will let eligible institutions mint and redeem Circle’s USDC around the clock, creating a bank route into stablecoin settlement across Asia.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US authorities won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2bn in Binance theft proceeds, part of $2.7bn frozen by government and private partners so far.

item.title: How to tell if my swap was sandwich attacked: spot the pattern
item.description: How to tell if my swap was sandwich attacked: find the same bot buying just before your swap and selling just after it in the same block and pool.

item.title: Common mistakes when bridging crypto: a pre-signing checklist
item.description: Common mistakes when bridging crypto include a wrong address, network or token, missing destination gas, and fake sites. Run these checks before signing.

item.title: Does My Exchange Support USDC Withdrawals to Polygon PoS?
item.description: To check whether an exchange supports USDC withdrawals to Polygon, open its USDC withdrawal network list and confirm Polygon PoS before sending a test amount.

item.title: How Should Beginners Choose an EigenLayer Operator?
item.description: A beginner checklist for choosing a restaking operator: compare its AVSs and Operator Sets, per-AVS commission, slashing and uptime history, and delegation access.

item.title: Did my ShibaSwap deposit fail, or are LP tokens hidden?
item.description: ShibaSwap LP tokens not showing in MetaMask? A successful Dig transaction means the deposit worked; import its minted LP contract on the same network to see your balance.

item.title: Why MetaMask rejects Solana and Bitcoin custom RPCs
item.description: Why can’t I add a non-EVM network to MetaMask with a custom RPC? MetaMask checks eth_chainId, so use a compatible Snap or chain-native wallet.

item.title: Berachain bridge: What a transfer really costs
item.description: How much are Berachain bridge fees? Expect source-chain gas, a bridge or messaging fee, and sometimes liquidity or swap deductions; the route and amount set the total.

item.title: How do you buy an ERC-20 token with hardware signing?
item.description: To buy an ERC-20 token with a hardware wallet, connect its Ethereum account, review the swap, authorize spending, sign the order, and verify receipt.

item.title: How Can You Verify an Omnibridge Token’s Ethereum Backing?
item.description: To verify an Omnibridge token backed on Ethereum, match its Gnosis Chain contract in the registry, then compare Ethereum reserves with its supply.

item.title: USDC on Polygon: Choose by Where Your Funds Are
item.description: Bridge or exchange withdrawal to get USDC on Polygon? Withdraw from an exchange that supports Polygon; bridge USDC from Ethereum when it is already in your wallet.

item.title: What Happens to Ethereum Tokens Locked by Omnibridge? The Return Path
item.description: What happens to Ethereum tokens locked by Omnibridge? The originals stay in contract escrow while matching tokens circulate on Gnosis Chain, then unlock on return.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department won authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds, as tracing and recovery efforts continue across crypto services.
